violations.text: The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Milk was observed held at 49 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Milk was placed in freezer, and refrigerator temperature will be adjusted colder. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Working containers of toppings are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Staff were observed not wearing hair restraints. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
Utensils were observed stored in room temperature stagnant water between uses. Utensils may be stored in water held at 135 degrees F or above. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
One small refrigerator with torn gasket dangling from the door was not in good repair, not in service at time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonia sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
The receptacle in the toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026

The ledge at the basement stair has an accumulation of soil residue and debris including nail. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
Inspector observed can opener installed on three bay (wash) sink. PIC informed to remove from 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2025
